scope: Bound existing shared audit growth and expose owner-only measured storage before any further configuration or trial; preserve all history and byte ceilings.
riskAnalysis: Count growth can consume storage, so original byte ceilings stay authoritative. This release is paid-disabled qualification only. Actual shared ledger utilization and conservative complete-artifact/failure headroom remain required before configuration or inference.

threatModel.assets: Immutable audit history, task authority, credentials, spending and cross-workspace isolation.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Owner authorization precedes read-only projection; all mutations retain existing CAS, runtime and task checks.
threatModel.abuseCases: History overwrite, unbounded growth, full registry partial writes, false paid readiness or unavailable cleanup.
threatModel.mitigations: Bound1024 append, unchanged byte caps, atomic preflight, earlier600 cleanup fallback, numeric-only projection and release fingerprint binding.

rollback: Retain current qualified paid-disabled Preview; revert reviewed source if qualification fails, never rewrite persisted records or revive old grants.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Capacity rejects non-array registry state, and unchanged inference parser remains authoritative.
negativePaths.stale-state: Existing task/runtime checks and CAS readback remain required.
negativePaths.concurrency: Real CAS conflict test retains concurrent historical row and appends once.
negativePaths.cancellation: Existing revocation bypasses new admission checks and retains earlier cleanup fallback.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No worker changes; immutable diagnostics and revocation byte reserve preserved.
negativePaths.api-outage: No provider calls in tests; telemetry read failure cannot grant clean authority.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Existing owner-before-read test and exact source task checks remain unchanged.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No budget changes, paid disabled; expanded remaining allowance is not increased.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Full registry and byte denials preserve unchanged raw CAS; emergencycleanup at1024 preserves history.

defects.rootCause: Central audit600 reached after configuration steps, blocking completion although separate assignment capacity remained.
defects.detectionGap: Separate operations telemetry did not report shared organization bytes and audit storage together.
defects.regression: Actual CAS appends beyond600, preserves history/concurrency, denies1025 and full registry/bytes; cleanup tested at1024.
defects.historicalPrevention: Owner-only numeric shared capacity exposes all bounded registries before fresh task/configuration; full trial byte proof remains explicit.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse same organization CAS and authorization controller; no competing journal or orchestration.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No package, lockfile, external service, worker or build-policy changes. New pure module fingerprint-bound.
proactiveReview.threats: Unbounded audit writes, false availability, data leakage or cleanup rejection at full capacity.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Count and byte guards fail closed, projection cannot authorize execution, cleanup earlierfallback retained.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Boundary, full registry, oversizedbytes, concurrency, readonlyprivacy and fullauditcleanup tested.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate WorkQA and EngineeringAuditor found no material defect; both require actual byte headroom before paid activation.
proactiveReview.recovery: Keep old claimed configuration and all historical evidence intact until reviewed cancellation; never retry refresh blindly.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused verification and fullSTRICT required; deployment and live reasoning are not inferred from fixtures.
